arguments.script: var map=UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsOfType<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.Tilemap>().Single(m=>m.name=="Ground — paint here");UnityEditor.Selection.activeGameObject=map.gameObject;UnityEditor.EditorApplication.ExecuteMenuItem("Window/2D/Tile Palette");UnityEditor.Tilemaps.GridPaintingState.palette=UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<UnityEngine.GameObject>("Assets/Tiles/UnifiedTerrain/Forest Palette.prefab");UnityEditor.Tilemaps.GridPaintingState.scenePaintTarget=map.gameObject;var view=UnityEditor.SceneView.lastActiveSceneView;if(view!=null){view.LookAt(new UnityEngine.Vector3(0,-1,0),UnityEngine.Quaternion.identity,6,true);view.Show();view.Repaint();}return "Level01 unified terrain selected; Forest Palette ready";
arguments.summary: Select unified terrain and its ready-to-paint Forest Palette
